# ZDentistry — Dental & Maxillofacial Surgery Clinic, Cuttack

> ZDentistry is a dental and oral & maxillofacial surgery clinic at 2B/109, Near Jugal Kishore Park, CDA Sector-9, Cuttack, Odisha 753014, India, led by Dr. Zuben Mohanty (MDS, Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon). Phone/WhatsApp: +91 89844 89929, +91 89844 69929. Open Monday–Saturday 10:00–14:00 and 17:00–21:00, Sunday 10:00–14:00. Rated 4.8/5 on Google.
